'''2017 Worlds Day 3 Justin Desai LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2017 World Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Justin Desai]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 World Championship]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 3
